# Competitive Signal Report — Enterprise AI Platform (Thursday, 30 July 2026)

> **Bottom line:** Competitors are pushing incremental AI capabilities, but the core market battle remains focused on platform breadth, demonstrable ROI, and analyst validation. Kore.ai's ABL and proven enterprise-grade platform continue to offer a distinct advantage against fragmented or narrowly focused offerings.

## Three signals that matter

### PolyAI Boosts Voice AI Latency Performance
**What happened —** (2026-07-30) PolyAI launched Dialog-RSN-1, a new real-time voice conversation model designed to significantly cut latency for AI-driven calls, aiming to make them more human-like. [siliconangle.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxPRjhwZFpjVG9aTDF4VmdfQkZvLWc4ekZpemFSWDJTVUtWSjdOa2dIbGVyWE9SQzlkYnRXZDc3UGViOHB3VEFtRmtVMnZaVGluTnB5Y3Q0R0pBNTU4T2FyMjVSaU5LMGFrc3A5aEZGYmhaWlF0UDFCYm1FN3NFdzBYWU4tRjJmT1VfeUJpRU1zaGFtTGs4a2l0VnhmbEp3T3ZiT19fR0Z2ejN5eTJmTF84aXhDUm92d0Z4bnc?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** While PolyAI focuses on voice latency, Kore.ai's true omnichannel platform and ABL's compile-time validation provide a more robust, enterprise-grade solution. We should emphasize our unified voice and digital capabilities and the deterministic nature of our agents, which prevents the "human-like" latency issues from impacting critical compliance or transactional flows.

### ServiceNow Grounds AI in Operations and Governance
**What happened —** (2026-07-30) ServiceNow highlighted a shift in business AI adoption, emphasizing grounding AI efforts in operations and governance, particularly after early failures. [Techgoondu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxOZGFtMEVwQ3BRc3BfZDh2dGZVQ1lWcDBiY0RXR28weDR3dDloWjRjZE1Ic21tVjViaC1qdXlfdGFsanI4RG85RXk1MVpnbVRhaHF3THo3S0pzY1drQ2RydXVvX3NpSFdZeVVlVDByOFpJRWlwLWY5UmtnSXJWYVg3SlNZaUdsY19NN20zZ2kwTXRMNV9WbWJMb1lhYUt0aUx1dm4wck1JX2lPSmpsZHgyUTIxNm9ESGZGOTF1b3RoRlVtX20tdEVCNlhBdWlYZw?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** This validates Kore.ai's long-standing emphasis on ABL for deterministic execution, compile-time validation, and robust governance. We can leverage this by positioning our platform as the mature, operationally grounded solution that avoids the pitfalls of purely prompt-based or less-governed AI implementations, especially for regulated industries.

### Cresta Unlocks Deeper Customer Conversation Intelligence
**What happened —** (2026-07-29) Cresta launched the next generation of Cresta Insights, aiming to unlock deeper, more actionable intelligence from customer conversations. [PR Newswire](https://news.google.?oc=5)
**What it means for Kore.ai —** Cresta's focus on conversation intelligence is a strength, but Kore.ai's platform offers broader, end-to-end automation and agentic capabilities beyond just insights. We can highlight our ability to not only analyze conversations but to proactively automate actions, orchestrate complex workflows, and provide true omnichannel experiences, backed by superior analyst validation in the core conversational AI for CX space.

## Watch for
- Continued emphasis from ServiceNow on operationalizing AI, which could drive further demand for robust governance and deterministic AI.
- PolyAI's progress in reducing voice latency and whether this translates into broader enterprise adoption or remains a niche improvement.

## Recommended actions
- Reinforce messaging around Kore.ai's ABL as the industry standard for deterministic, governed, and auditable AI agents, directly addressing the operational grounding ServiceNow highlighted.
- Continue to emphasize Kore.ai's true omnichannel capabilities and analyst leadership in Conversational AI for Customer Service to differentiate from voice-first or insights-focused competitors.
- Arm sales with specific talking points that contrast Kore.ai's full-lifecycle agentic platform with point solutions or those with narrow focus areas.
